role: Secondary exposed-data mechanical census, not translation or qualification of a true formatter.
emissions: Each two-digit code emits itself; a code starting0 may alternatively omit that leading0. No deleted nonzero digits or free repairs. This memoryless formatter is an unverified hypothesis, not the demonstrated source decoder.
framing: Compare whole numeric utterance versus each observed numeric run treated as a complete frame. Only a conditional boundary assumption; do not assume each run is one atomic word.
counts: Exact dynamic-programming counts of all numeric code streams; not counts of meanings/English translations. Store arbitrary-precision counts as decimal strings. No English labels or probabilities over paths fitted.
controls: For all100 inventory count equals Fibonacci(n+1) for EVERY n-digit string: closed-form digit-relabel/shuffle invariance checked. For fixed supplied streams, these are not the earlier79zero alignments; many other code streams are allowed here.
interpretation: Unique count for a one-digit anchor is conditional numerical representation only. Space-induced ambiguity reduction does not establish a formatter, word meaning or cross-source shared algorithm. No semantic heldout claim.
